rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a work widely regarded as exceptionally good or artistically accomplished.

example.english: This painting is truly a masterpiece; no wonder so many people praise it.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫真係傑作，難怪咁多人讚。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 waa2 zan1 hai6 git6 zok3 naan4 gwaai3 gam3 do1 jan4 zaan3

rows.note: Use this colloquial, often online expression for a work judged extraordinarily brilliant, rather than specifically critically acclaimed.

example.english: This anime is truly a masterpiece; I couldn't stop watching once I started.
example.traditional: 呢套動畫真係神作，我一睇就停唔到。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 dung6 waa2 zan1 hai6 san4 zok3 ngo5 jat1 tai2 zau6 ting4 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when highlighting the work that best represents or stands out in a person's career.

example.english: This film is his most important masterpiece since his debut.
example.traditional: 呢套戲係佢出道以嚟最重要嘅代表作。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 hai6 keoi5 ceot1 dou6 ji5 lai4 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 doi6 biu2 zok3
